name: Twingate
author: Horacio Granillo
description: Twingate status, connect and disconnect, searchable resource list with copy and open-in-browser, per-resource authentication, exit node picker, and account switcher in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Connect or disconnect Twingate, search resources, copy addresses, authenticate locked resources, and switch exit nodes or accounts.

schema.label: Status poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to run twingate-notifier status. The daemon has been seen to stop answering under frequent polling, so keep this conservative.

schema.label: Resource list interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read the full resource list. Auth countdowns update locally between polls.

schema.label: Show hidden resources
schema.description: Include resources the client hides (client_visibility 2), matching twingate resources --all.

schema.label: Notify on connection changes
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when Twingate goes online, offline, or the service stops.

schema.label: Resource rows shown
schema.description: Rows drawn before the list is clipped. Use the search box to reach the rest. 0 shows every resource.

schema.label: Check for plugin updates
schema.description: Off by default. When on, checks once a day whether this plugin's checkout is behind its origin and offers an update in the panel. Reaches GitHub; nothing is downloaded or applied until you choose the row.

schema.label: Recent resources remembered
schema.description: Names kept in shell.json for the RECENT section. 0 stores none.
